title: OpenEPCIS Data Carrier Authentication Vocabulary
description:
Terms for binding a physical data carrier (an NFC chip, a RAIN RFID
tag, a signed QR code) to a serialised GS1 identifier through EPCIS events, publishing the
carrier's authentication keys to authorised parties, and recording each authenticated scan.

Today the vocabulary covers NTAG 424 DNA Secure Unique NFC (SUN / Secure Dynamic Messaging,
NXP AN12196): the tag mirrors encrypted PICC data and a CMAC into the Digital Link URL it
emits, and a verifier that holds the tag's keys can prove the chip is genuine and the URL
was not copied. RAIN RFID (ISO/IEC 29167 tag authentication) and signed QR codes reuse the
same profile and status terms with their own scheme.

EPCIS 2.0 Extension:
This vocabulary is a first-class EPCIS 2.0 extension per Section 12.3. Declare it using:
  GS1-Extensions: carrier=https://ref.openepcis.org/extensions/common/carrier/

Event lifecycle:
- reserving (ObjectEvent ADD, brand owner): the serials and, sealed, their per-serial SDM
  keys (carrier:sdmMetaReadKey, carrier:sdmFileReadKey), the key reference and the profile.
- encoding (TransactionEvent, labeller, CBV encoding): the chip UID bound to the serial.
- commissioning (ObjectEvent ADD, manufacturer): nothing carrier-specific.
- inspecting (ObjectEvent OBSERVE, resolver): each authenticated scan with its read counter
  and verdict, disposition conformant or non_conformant.

Key fields are stored sealed: enc:a256gcm:<kid>:<base64url(nonce || ciphertext || tag)>,
AES-256-GCM under the wrapping key the carrier:keyRef names, with the canonical identifier
as associated data. Document-level security decides who sees the event; the wrapping key
decides who can use it.

GS1 Web Vocabulary and schema.org have no terms for carrier binding or carrier
authentication keys; GS1 General Specifications call the physical medium a "data carrier".

References:
- NXP AN12196, NTAG 424 DNA and NTAG 424 DNA TagTamper features and hints
- NXP AN10922, Symmetric key diversifications
- GS1 General Specifications, section 2 (data carriers)
- ISO/IEC 29167 (RAIN RFID tag authentication)

classes.label: Carrier Authentication Profile
classes.comment: How a carrier presents itself at a scan: the scheme, the URL parameters it mirrors into, and how its keys derive. Mirrors the tag's file settings so a verifier reads the URL the way the tag writes it.

classes.label: Carrier Verification
classes.comment: The answer of a verifier to one scan: identifier, status, read counter and key reference.

properties.label: Authentication Profile
properties.comment: The carrier:AuthProfile the keys of this event were written for.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The profile describes the tag's file settings; needed by the verifier, not by the public.

properties.label: Authentication Status
properties.comment: The verdict of this scan (carrier:AuthStatus), beside the CBV disposition conformant / non_conformant of the inspecting event.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The verdict is the answer the scanner receives; it reveals nothing about keys or the chip.

properties.label: Bound At
properties.comment: When the tap was bound to the capturing party's identity (the moment possession and identity were paired), ISO 8601.
properties.accessLevelRationale: Binding time is scan history of the item.

properties.label: Carrier Type
properties.comment: The chip or carrier product, e.g. NTAG424DNA, NTAG424DNA-TT.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The carrier product reveals the security level of the label; operational detail of the owner and its labeller.

properties.label: Key Diversification
properties.comment: What the per-carrier keys derive from under the master key: sgtin (the canonical identifier, keys exist before the tag does) or uid (the chip, AN10922 classic).
properties.accessLevelRationale: Part of the authentication profile; key-management detail.

properties.label: Encrypted File Data Parameter
properties.comment: Name of the URL query parameter carrying encrypted file data, when the tag mirrors any.

properties.label: Key Reference
properties.comment: Names the wrapping key (kid) that sealed the key fields of this event, e.g. benelog/lot-2026-10/k1. Rotation is a new kid; old events stay readable while the old key is kept.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The key reference names the owner's wrapping key; harmless alone, but key-management detail.

properties.label: MAC Input
properties.comment: What the tag MACs besides the session (carrier:MacInput).

properties.label: MAC Parameter
properties.comment: Name of the URL query parameter the tag mirrors the truncated SDM MAC into, e.g. cmac.

properties.label: PICC Data Encrypted
properties.comment: Whether the PICC data is AES-encrypted with K_SDMMetaRead (true) or mirrored in plain hex (false, not supported by the OpenEPCIS verifier yet).

properties.label: PICC Data Parameter
properties.comment: Name of the URL query parameter the tag mirrors the (encrypted) PICC data into, e.g. picc.

properties.label: Read Counter
properties.comment: The carrier's read counter as the scan revealed it (SDMReadCtr). The verifier refuses a counter that did not advance past the last recorded scan.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The read counter is a per-item scan history; for an owner with sales data it can become personal data of the buyer.

properties.label: SDM File Read Key
properties.comment: K_SDMFileRead of the carrier bound to the event's identifier, sealed (enc:a256gcm:<kid>:...). Derives the session MAC key that verifies the mirrored CMAC. The event that carries it is the key record; a verifier takes the youngest.
properties.accessLevelRationale: K_SDMFileRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge the SUN MAC. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

properties.label: SDM Meta Read Key
properties.comment: K_SDMMetaRead of the carrier bound to the event's identifier, sealed (enc:a256gcm:<kid>:...). Decrypts the mirrored PICC data. One serial per event, or absent when the file-read key serves both purposes.
properties.accessLevelRationale: K_SDMMetaRead is a secret key; whoever holds it can forge PICC data. Sealed in the event, readable only by the verifier that holds the wrapping key.

properties.label: Tap Reference
properties.comment: On a business event (accepting, receiving, repairing, inspecting, shipping, ...): the eventID of the verified inspecting event this action rests on. The party that captured the event held the item when it tapped; the tap id is single-use and bound to that party's identity by the verifier.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The tap reference links a business step to a scan; who scanned when is the owner's and the acting party's concern.

properties.label: Carrier UID
properties.comment: The chip's unique identifier in upper-case hex (7 bytes for NTAG 424 DNA, e.g. 04DE5F1EACC040), bound to the event's identifier at encoding. A verifier compares it with the UID the PICC data reveals.
properties.accessLevelRationale: The chip UID identifies the physical carrier; it lets a party track an item across readers and is of use only to the owner, the labeller and the verifier.

properties.label: URL Template
properties.comment: The NDEF URL as written to the tag, with {gtin}, {serial}, {picc}, {cmac} placeholders, e.g. https://id.epc.is/01/{gtin}/21/{serial}?picc={picc}&cmac={cmac}.

enumerations.label: Carrier Authentication Scheme
enumerations.comment: How a carrier proves itself at a scan.

values.label: NTAG 424 DNA Secure Dynamic Messaging
values.comment: NXP NTAG 424 DNA Secure Unique NFC: encrypted PICC data and a truncated CMAC mirrored into the URL (AN12196).

values.label: Signed QR Code
values.comment: A QR code whose payload carries a digital signature over the identifier (reserved; no profile defined yet).

values.label: RAIN RFID ISO/IEC 29167
values.comment: RAIN RFID tag authentication per ISO/IEC 29167 (reserved; no profile defined yet).

enumerations.label: Carrier Authentication Status
enumerations.comment: The verdict of one authenticated scan of a data carrier, as the verifier records it in the inspecting event and answers it to the scanner.

values.label: MAC Invalid
values.comment: PICC data decrypted but the MAC did not match the file-read key: wrong key or tampered URL.

values.label: PICC Data Invalid
values.comment: The mirrored PICC data did not decrypt to a chip UID and read counter under the meta-read key: wrong key, foreign carrier or malformed URL.

values.label: Replay
values.comment: Cryptographically fine, but the read counter did not advance past the last recorded scan: a copied URL (photographed tap, cloned code).

values.label: UID Mismatch
values.comment: The chip UID in the PICC data differs from the UID bound to the identifier at encoding.

values.label: Unknown Carrier
values.comment: No key record exists for the identifier: never reserved, or not readable by this verifier.

values.label: Verified
values.comment: PICC data decrypted, the MAC matched the carrier's key and the read counter advanced: a genuine carrier, scanned afresh.

enumerations.label: MAC Input
enumerations.comment: What the tag feeds into the SDM MAC besides the session key: nothing, or the encrypted file data.

values.label: Encrypted File Data
values.comment: The MAC covers the upper-case hex of the encrypted file data followed by the MAC parameter name.

values.label: None
values.comment: SDMMACInputOffset equals SDMMACOffset: the MAC covers the session only.
